execution_rule: The public preregistration gate is satisfied. Before confirmatory outcomes, freeze and hash the executable analysis implementation and environment lock. Then run only the preregistered feasibility smoke test and, if it passes, the preregistered data-condition experiment. Do not alter donor order, panel-selection rule, probe seeds, endpoints or stopping rules after outcome inspection.
next_required_action: Freeze the executable implementation and environment lock, record their hashes, and run the preregistered feasibility smoke test before confirmatory outcome collection.
hash_scope: SHA-256 values were recorded for the original archived files. This GitHub copy has renamed paths and labels, so its edited files do not match those archive hashes.
